assessments.reasoning: The checkmk-publisher acquisition returned HTTP 200 and the complete 15,174-byte checkmk/checkmk.in from the libcheck/check repository at commit 11970a7e112dfe243a2e68773f014687df2900e8. Its reported full-range SHA-256 is 05f2c384a0dfeaf1ade50dbcb4973a7db80d4122cdb59d5c47ae064429b7a491. The header identifies the Check helper and credits Micah Cowan, whose 2006 and 2010 copyright line precedes the grant. The condition is retention of that copyright in source distributions. The parenthetical comparison with modified BSD is the author’s explanatory comment.

The index-lifecycle acquisition returned the complete 2,156-byte decision three-project-notices-lifecycle-2026-11-28 from software-commons/license-index at commit cffd21c29084a60c2fb00a9ee0d2c52780246c02, with reported full-range SHA-256 3c83323a86c0974f44b25b8f52c632400dd9834cab9397d711e0d72250ae7280. The checkmk row gives prospective entity 5a7a653636384e4193aa56851d5b499d, matching the identifier portion of e-5a7a653636384e4193aa56851d5b499d. It gives the name Check checkmk notice, kind license, edition checkmk-captured-reference, revision sha256:05f2c384a0dfeaf1ade50dbcb4973a7db80d4122cdb59d5c47ae064429b7a491 and lifecycle active. The row’s companion note ties the scope to the same pinned helper and comment.

challenge.method: I inspected the complete pinned Check source, checked its repository path and authorship, and traced the cited comment from the copyright line to the start of the AWK code. I then compared the publisher URL and reported full-body SHA-256 with the editorial row and checked each requested identity and lifecycle field.
challenge.results: The Check repository pin leads to the cited AWK helper. Micah Cowan’s copyright line and redistribution grant appear before BEGIN, and the grant requires retaining the copyright in source distributions. The explanatory comment closes before the code. The editorial note points to the same file and distinguishes the separate package licensing file. The checkmk row carries the matching entity, name, kind, edition and digest and assigns active status.

limitations: The active classification concerns Index lookup for this exact captured notice. Other Check files and versions, applicability to other works, legal equivalence, reuse and installation require separate evidence.
The digest comparison uses the acquisition tool’s reported full-body hashes. The policy commit and bundle hash were supplied as assessment identifiers and were outside the three acquired sources.
reasoning: The project’s pinned file establishes the helper-specific notice and its source-distribution condition. The committed Index decision supplies the exact editorial identity and active lifecycle for that same captured file.
